A high bird's-eye view of ONE lonely floating tree island, placed far away in the TOP RIGHT CORNER of a tall portrait fantasy game background. Most of this picture is open blue air and softly painted clouds far below. The entire tree AND its little island are confined to the UPPER THIRD of the picture. The lower TWO THIRDS are empty spacious sky and distant soft white clouds. An enormous sense of airy distance separates this small distant destination from the viewer. The island must not extend down into the center of the image.

LOOKING DOWN STEEPLY AT THE TOP OF THE TREE, about 75 degrees downward. A broad round extremely lush domed treetop seen from above, like a richly detailed circular bouquet of rounded leafy crowns. We see sunlit upper surfaces of overlapping dense foliage, not the sides of branches. Bright lime-green and golden-green clusters with emerald shadows and delicate individual leaf brushwork, natural irregular rounded edges, beautifully full and healthy. The trunk is foreshortened and mostly concealed beneath the massive dense crown. NO tall exposed vertical trunk, NO side elevation of a tree. A modest crescent of grassy earth and exposed roots is visible around the near edge of the canopy, clearly viewed from ABOVE. A few pale warm gray rocks, tiny wildflowers, strong twisting roots gripping a small irregular piece of terrain pulled up out of the ground by the great tree. Very short broken rocky underside and hanging root ends. The tree is large relative to its tiny patch of terrain, but the entire island is distant, floating high in the upper-right of the frame.

Strong composition: broad rounded treetop fills the upper right quarter, a small fringe of grass and rootbound rock immediately below it, then uninterrupted open azure sky all the way to the bottom. The uppermost foliage may be cropped by the top and right edge of the image. The center, left side and bottom are gentle blue atmosphere. High above a sea of white clouds, no visible horizon line, no mountains. No ground-level view. Warm upper-left sunlight, soft atmospheric depth, serene and enchanting solitude.

Premium detailed hand-painted 2D fantasy mobile RPG environment art. Warm rich greens, warm honey-brown roots, vibrant clear blue skies. Soft painterly foliage with crisp elegant silhouette, sophisticated light and shadow, charming adventurous style. Natural organic tree silhouette, no geometric slabs. A clean background layer only: no ships, no people, no UI, no banners, no text, no buildings, no docks, no border. 9:16 portrait composition, distant isolated lush treetop island high in the upper-right, generous empty sky for foreground game objects.
